start.text: (His mother asleep on the cot. Ravi, in a vest, at a gas stove.) Don't wake her. (He makes tea without asking.) I walked out of quarantine. Nobody stopped me.

tea.text: (He won't talk about HIVR. He talks about her tablets, the landlord, the tea.) You were right not to stay that night. I wouldn't have.

choices.text: (Take the ID he puts on the table.)

bye.text: (He holds the door.) Go. Before it's dark.

after.text: (He puts a finger to his lips and nods at the cot.)
